critical_code_review_comments: renderSignatureSvg() coordinate regex /[ML]?\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)/g correctly handles the 'M x.x,y.y L x.x,y.y' format produced by SignaturePad (locationX/Y.toFixed(1)).
Min viewBox width/height of 20 properly guards the single-point edge case.
preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' keeps signature aspect ratio when scaling into the 280x90 display area — good choice.

The remaining real-world verification (signature visible in actual generated PDF on iPhone) requires native device testing which is out of scope for the web preview / automated tests.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: renderSignatureSvg() used hardcoded viewBox='0 0 320 180'. SignaturePad records raw touch coordinates from the canvas, which on a ~370px wide iPhone canvas can produce x values >320, so those strokes were rendered outside the SVG viewBox and clipped, making the signature invisible. Fix: parse all M/L coords from the path string(s), compute bounding box (minX,minY,maxX,maxY), add 8px padding, and use that as the viewBox. preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' ensures the signature scales to fit the 280x90 display area without distortion. Verified with the exact bug scenario (Test 3 — points 400,500,450 in X — would have been outside the old 0..320 box; now they fall inside viewBox 392..508).
